facts.fact: 新年前一夜，全城关张，只剩空街。
facts.anchor: Everything closed down the night before the new year.

facts.fact: Kiamling 与 Jingling 蹲下给父母和祖父上香。
facts.anchor: Kiamling and Jingling squatted down to light joss sticks for their parents and grandfather.

facts.fact: Hoi 也端着自己的祭品出来，把纸元宝一张张放进火里，再放纸衣。
facts.anchor: Hoi came out with his own ancestral offerings. He placed the folded paper ingots one by one into the flames, followed by paper clothing for the afterlife.

facts.fact: Kiamling 笑 Hoi 像只落水的老鼠；他刚洗过头，头发散着。
facts.anchor: “You look like a drowned rat.” Kiamling smirked.

facts.fact: 一条蛇从 Hoi 的袖子里滑出，绕在他手指上，她没有立刻动手。
facts.anchor: A snake slid out of Hoi’s sleeve and twisted round his fingers.

facts.fact: 立法局年前最后一晚把发言机会给了 Ng 律师，让他讲香港的文化遗产与建医院的请款。
facts.anchor: Magnanimously, they had given Barrister Ng the floor to talk about Hong Kong’s cultural heritage and his petition for funds to open a hospital.

facts.fact: Ng 几乎不用 Kiamling 劝，就答应尽量把议事拖长。
facts.anchor: He had agreed, after very little cajoling from Kiamling, to keep the assembly occupied for as long as he could.

facts.fact: Madam Yau 在春芽亭把流民与孤魂都聚了起来。
facts.anchor: Inside the Pavilion of Spring Buds, Madam Yau had gathered all the waifs and strays.

facts.fact: 活人的位子够坐，给死人留的还多出一倍不止。
facts.anchor: There were seats aplenty for the living, and more than double the quantity for the dead.

facts.fact: 供桌正中是一条清蒸大鱼，配着葱和姜。
facts.anchor: A huge steamed fish sat at the centre of the array, garnished in spring onions and ginger.

facts.fact: Jingling 往姐姐碗里夹鱼，凑近说这担子不全是她一个人的。
facts.anchor: “Remember, it’s not on your shoulders alone, no matter if Por Por made you feel that way.”

facts.fact: Hoi 说真担心的话，他的脸会挨着她的屁股。
facts.anchor: “if you are worried, remember my face is going to be next to your butt.”

facts.fact: 马上那个人穿着厚重的欧洲大衣，脑袋整个不见了。
facts.anchor: The man mounted atop it was wearing a heavy European overcoat and entirely missing his head.

facts.fact: 窗下有只皱绿脸的小妖扑来咬她的手，她及时把窗板拍上。
facts.anchor: She slammed the shutter closed just in time.

facts.fact: 她发现所有人都在看她，这处境与祖母当年叠在一起。
facts.anchor: Kiamling was disconcerted to find all eyes on her.

facts.fact: 她分派 Madam Yau 领 yiugwai 大游行，把本地人引开危险地带。
facts.anchor: “Madam Yau will lead the yiugwai in a grand parade to draw the locals away from the areas of danger.

facts.fact: Carpenter Leung 困在新警署的墙里，正在变成怪物。
facts.anchor: He is trapped in there, turning into a monster within the walls.

facts.fact: 楼上那间房中央，Archie 蜷成一团，四周是一圈盐米。
facts.anchor: In the centre of the room, Archie lay curled up in a ball.

facts.fact: 他醒过来后一只眼回到从前的蓝，另一只还是红的。
facts.anchor: One of his eyes had turned back to the familiar blue, but the other remained red.

facts.fact: 章末两人的手掌隔着几寸悬着，那几寸像万里长城。
facts.anchor: A few inches lay between them, but in that moment it could have been the ten-thousand-li wall.
